messages.subject: coord_trans (negate and user defined function)
parts:
Hi,

I want to transform the coordinates by negating them. However, the
following command does not work. Does anybody know to specify the
negation function?

qplot(1:10, 1:10) + coord_trans(x='-')

I also try to supply a user defined function, but it doesn't work
either. Is there a way to specify a user defined function to
coord_trans? Thanks!

qplot(1:10, 1:10) + coord_trans(x=function(v) {-v})

http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/coord_trans.html

--
Regards,
Peng

messages.author: c21e804e07c5e732
messages.subject: Re: coord_trans (negate and user defined function)
parts:
Hi,

qplot(1:10, 1:10) + scale_y_reverse()
qplot(1:10, 1:10) + scale_y_continuous(trans='reverse')

I finally find the above commands. I think that it would better if
there are some links to these two functions from
http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/coord_trans.html.
